constraints.definition:
CHECK (
CASE
    WHEN (feature_key = ANY (ARRAY['lining'::text, 'adjustable_strap'::text, 'pockets'::text, 'zip_closure'::text, 'machine_washable'::text])) THEN (jsonb_typeof(value) = 'boolean'::text)
    WHEN (feature_key = 'capacity_litres'::text) THEN
    CASE
        WHEN (jsonb_typeof(value) = 'number'::text) THEN (((value)::text)::numeric > (0)::numeric)
        ELSE false
    END
    WHEN (feature_key = 'use_cases'::text) THEN
    CASE
        WHEN (jsonb_typeof(value) = 'array'::text) THEN ((jsonb_array_length(value) >= 1) AND (jsonb_array_length(value) <= 12))
        ELSE false
    END
    ELSE false
END)
